name: GitHub API
description: Read repos, manage issues, trigger Actions workflows, and post commit statuses with the GitHub REST API.

requiredSecrets.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
requiredSecrets.reason: GitHub Personal Access Token or GitHub App installation token

requiredSecrets.name: GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
requiredSecrets.reason: Shared secret for verifying incoming GitHub webhook payloads

postInstallNotes:
1. Create a fine-grained PAT at github.com/settings/tokens — grant only the permissions your app needs.
2. Use `GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET` + `verifyWebhookSignature` to safely handle incoming webhook events.
3. For GitHub Apps (recommended for production), use `@octokit/auth-app` instead of a PAT.
